summary: The scoped ordinary-flow audit confirmed Go manager and host Changes/refresh/disposal choreography, with focused Go/race/vet, 46 host/runtime Node tests, strict WASM smoke, 20-action native replay, and real-HTTP browser smoke passing. The XR-T2 adversarial review then exposed an open bridge boundary gap: an own accessor can reenter a failing setChildInputs call and a proxy can supply inherited values after ownKeys reports the expected schema. This audit did not close that finding; full inherited runner and seeded oracle remain pending. Details and retained probe outputs are in A-CONTRACT.md and coordination/reviews/.
